map.：直观呈现分支、循环与可选部分，便于理解复杂正则的匹配顺序。: : Intuitively shows branches, loops, and optional parts, making complex regex matching order easier to understand.

map.`a(b|c)*` → 起始 a，循环分支 b/c 的状态图。: `a(b|c)*` → starts with a, loops over the b/c branch.
map.从左到右的轨道即匹配路径。: The left-to-right track is the matching path.
map.为什么图里出现了我没写的分支？: Why does the diagram show branches I didn't write?
map.多半是量词与可选符（?、*、{n,m}）造成的：它们在图上表现为「可跳过的回路」: Mostly caused by quantifiers and optionals (? * {n,m}): on the diagram they appear as "skippable loops" or "repeating loops," looking like extra branches but actually equivalent expressions. Also, non-capturing groups (?:...) and lookaheads (?=...) have special representations that are easily confused with normal groups.
map.可视化流程：先以 new RegExp 校验合法性，再分词为正则 token，构: Visualization flow: it first validates legality with new RegExp, then tokenizes into regex tokens, builds a state set containing start + accept and transition edges, and lists labels and transitions state by state
map.原理：把正则分词为 token，构造含 start / accept 的状态集与: How it works: tokenize the regex, build a state set with start/accept states and transition edges, then render an AST hierarchy tree plus a linear state chain (this version provides the tree and state chain, not per-branch path layout).
map.价值：以层级树呈现分组、量词与分支的嵌套结构，以状态链呈现转移顺序，便于理解复杂: Value: the hierarchy tree shows nested groups, quantifiers and alternation; the state chain shows transition order, making complex regexes easier to understand.
map.把正则渲染成层级树与线性状态链理解结构。: Render a regex as a hierarchy tree and linear state chain to understand its structure.
map.读懂别人留下的复杂正则：按层级树与状态链展开，看清分支、量词与分组的嵌套关系，再: Read a complex regex left by someone else: expand the hierarchy tree and state chain to see how alternation, quantifiers and groups nest before editing.

map.用语法树核对分组、量词与分支的嵌套结构。: Use the syntax tree to check how groups, quantifiers and alternation nest.
map.读懂复杂正则：先看语法树分支/量词节点，再用线性词元顺序核对 token 排列；: Read a complex regex: inspect alternation/quantifier nodes in the syntax tree, then use the linear token order to check token arrangement; do not treat the token order as a match path.
map.`a(b|c)*`：语法树显示“分组 (b|c) 被 * 重复”的嵌套；线性词元: `a(b|c)*`: the syntax tree shows the group (b|c) repeated by *; the linear token order lists a, (, b, |, c, ), * to show arrangement only, with no loop edges.
map.先看语法树的层级（分组、量词、分支嵌套），再看线性词元顺序核对 token 排列: First read the syntax-tree hierarchy (groups, quantifiers, alternation), then use the linear token order to check token arrangement; the latter is not a match path.
map.能看出匹配路径或量词回路吗？: Can I see match paths or quantifier loops?
map.不能。本页不构造 NFA/DFA 状态图，量词只在语法树节点体现，线性词元顺序不: No. This page does not build an NFA/DFA state graph; quantifiers appear only as AST nodes and the linear token order has no branches or loops. Use live match highlighting or a new RegExp test to judge matching.
